title: Hasbi Rabbi
intro: A well-loved ilahi: “My Lord is enough for me”.

learn.label: Hasbi Rabbi
learn.ar: حَسْبِي رَبِّي جَلَّ اللَّه ۝ مَا فِي قَلْبِي غَيْرُ اللَّه ۝ نُورُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّه ۝ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّه
learn.tr: Hasbee Rabbee jallallaah · Maa fee qalbee ghayrullaah · Noori Muhammad sallallaah · Laa ilaaha illallaah
learn.en: My Lord, Allah the Majestic, is enough for me · In my heart there is only Allah · My light is Muhammad – may Allah bless him · There is no god except Allah

items: Hasbee Rabbee jallallaah – Allah, the Most High, is enough for me
Maa fee qalbee ghayrullaah – in my heart there is only Allah
Noori Muhammad sallallaah – my light is Muhammad
Laa ilaaha illallaah – there is no god except Allah

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: A Muslim relies only on Allah (SWT), believes in Him, does what He commands and keeps away from what He forbids. Muhammad (SAW) is a light in our hearts because he is our example in how we behave.
